profile.headline: VP Software Engineer @ JPMorganChase | AI Engineer | Low-Latency Distributed Systems | Java | LangGraph | LangChain | MCP | Agentic AI
profile.summary:
Staff-level Software Engineer specializing in low-latency distributed systems, scalable backend platforms, and production-grade Agentic AI.

I design and build high-performance software that operates reliably under demanding workloads—from mission-critical, real-time distributed systems to enterprise AI platforms powered by LLMs and autonomous agents.

My experience spans Java, Spring Boot, distributed systems, event-driven architectures, microservices, concurrent programming, and cloud-native application development. I enjoy solving complex engineering problems involving scalability, resiliency, throughput, and system performance.

Alongside backend engineering, I’ve built production-ready AI applications using LangGraph, LangChain, Model Context Protocol (MCP), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), vector databases, workflow orchestration, and multi-agent architectures.

I believe successful AI systems are built on great software engineering. Reliability, observability, scalability, orchestration, security, and clean architecture are what transform AI prototypes into production platforms.

Core areas of expertise:

• Low-Latency Distributed Systems
• High-Performance Java Applications
• Distributed Systems & Microservices
• Event-Driven Architecture
• Concurrent & Multi-Threaded Programming
• Java / Spring Boot
• Agentic AI & Multi-Agent Systems
• LangGraph • LangChain • MCP
• LLM Applications & RAG
• AI Workflow Orchestration
• Cloud-Native Platform Engineering
• Scalable APIs & Backend Architecture

I enjoy leading complex technical initiatives, mentoring engineers, and designing systems that deliver measurable business impact through strong engineering fundamentals and modern AI capabilities.

positions.title: Vice President | Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
Designing and building high-performance, low-latency distributed systems that process real-time data at scale.

• Building low-latency, high-throughput Java applications for mission-critical platforms.
• Designing scalable distributed systems and event-driven architectures.
• Developing concurrent and multi-threaded backend services with a strong emphasis on 
   performance, resiliency, and reliability.
• Leading technical design discussions, architecture decisions, and engineering best practices.
• Driving clean code, Test-Driven Development (TDD), code quality, and CI/CD automation.
• Mentoring engineers and promoting modern software engineering practices, including responsible 
   AI-assisted development.
• Collaborating across engineering teams to deliver secure, scalable, and production-ready solutions.

positions.title: Senior Java Developer
positions.description:
Works on a credit risk application
- Using Core Java, J2EE, Hibernate, Spring, DWR, JSP, Struts, EHCache, Eclipse, Web Services (Axis, Axis2), Oracle 10g. Also using POI for creating various file formats based upon the Office Open XML standards 
- Helping the team on adopting and implementing Agile software development

positions.title: Senior Java Developer
positions.description:
•	Java developer on the Configuration Management System (CMS). The Configuration Management
       System provides pertinent information about the configuration of the IT environment to other processes in 
       the firm such as Change, Problem and incident management.
•	Developing new features and enhancements for CMS.
